title: Satisfaction with Success with Kahran & Alva10's co-founder, Lena Chaihorsky
summary: Kahran talks with Lena Chaihorsky, co-founder of precision-medicine company Alva10, not about her business but about how seven years of building has changed what success means to her. She talks about the shift from achievement-as-joy to joy-in-the-journey, how being a working parent is a superpower, and how marriage and motherhood made her a better entrepreneur (and vice versa).
topics: MFA in poetry as a turn

intents.display: to hear a founder talk about what success actually feels like after seven years
to think about being a working parent as a superpower
